Definition: from G4486; a "rag," i.e. piece of cloth:--cloth.
BiblicalUsage: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the new cloth and the old garment cannot be patched together, and Jesus did not come to patch what is worn out.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
